## Checklist

- [ ] I started from an up-to-date `main` and worked on my own branch
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes (warnings are acceptable; errors are not)

- [ ] The C code matches the professor's slides (same names, same logic, one statement per line)
- [ ] Step generators use symbolic line labels, not raw line numbers
- [ ] New operations have tests (reference model + invariants), including empty list and "not found"
- [ ] All text is in `src/i18n/fr.ts`; captions wrap code identifiers in backticks
- [ ] I checked light theme, dark theme and presentation mode
- [ ] I did not commit `node_modules/` or `dist/`
